title: Beach Mat with Inflatable Neck Support – Sand-Proof
descriptionHtml:
Lie comfortably on the beach – without sand everywhere

A regular blanket on the beach collects sand and becomes hard to lie on. And without support for your neck it quickly becomes uncomfortable.

Sand-proof mat with built-in pillow

The mat has a sand-proof fabric that doesn't collect sand and an inflatable neck support for better comfort. It's easy to fold up and carry with you.

Features

  • Sand-proof fabric that keeps the mat clean
  • Inflatable neck support for comfort
  • Foldable and easy to carry
  • Moisture-proof – good on grass too
  • Repair kit included

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
